query:
UPDATE jobs SET
             state = ?,
             error = COALESCE(?, error),
             position = CASE WHEN ? THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), 0) + 1 FROM jobs)
                             ELSE position END,
             started_at = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE started_at END,
             finished_at = CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE finished_at END
         WHERE id = ? AND state = ?
